name: apple-mcp
description: Apple MCP tools for contacts, notes, messages, mail, reminders, calendar, and maps integration
long_description: Apple MCP gives LLMs access to Apple's native apps including Contacts, Notes, Messages, Mail, Reminders, Calendar, and Maps. This integration allows LLMs to interact with these apps seamlessly, enabling comprehensive automation of daily tasks like managing contacts, creating notes, sending messages, handling emails, setting reminders, managing calendar events, and navigating with Maps.

tools.name: list_reminder_lists
tools.description: List all Apple Reminders lists with their number of open reminders.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List or search Apple Reminders, sorted by due date (undated last). Filters combine. By default only open (not completed) reminders are returned.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder in Apple Reminders. Uses the default list if none given.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Change fields of an existing reminder. Only the fields given are changed; pass null for notes or dueDate to clear them.

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.description: Mark a reminder as completed (or reopen it with completed: false).

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.description: Permanently delete a reminder. Requires confirm: true; otherwise previews.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List all Apple Calendar calendars with their account and writability.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: List Apple Calendar events in a time range, sorted by start. Defaults to the next 7 days. The range may not exceed 4 years. Recurring events appear once per occurrence.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create an event in Apple Calendar. A date-only start (YYYY-MM-DD) creates an all-day event; timed events default to 1 hour if no end is given. Uses the default calendar if none is given.

tools.name: update_calendar_event
tools.description: Change fields of an existing event. Only the fields given are changed; pass null for location, notes or url to clear them. For recurring events pass occurrenceStart and choose span.

tools.name: delete_calendar_event
tools.description: Permanently delete a calendar event. Requires confirm: true; otherwise previews. For recurring events pass occurrenceStart and choose span.

tools.name: list_note_folders
tools.description: List all Apple Notes folders with their account and note count.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List Apple Notes, sorted by last modified, newest first. Returns snippets only; use read_note for the full text.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read one Apple Note in full (plain text, optionally raw HTML). Locked (password-protected) notes return no text.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create an Apple Note. With format text the body is converted line by line; the title becomes the note's heading. Uses the default folder if none is given.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Change an existing note. title renames it, body REPLACES everything below the title, append adds to the end (body and append are mutually exclusive). Requires confirm: true (otherwise previews) when replacing the body or when the note has attachments or is shared; renaming or appending to a plain note applies directly.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note (moves it to "Recently Deleted"). Requires confirm: true; otherwise previews.

tools.name: list_message_chats
tools.description: List recent Messages (iMessage/SMS) conversations, newest first: chat id, display name (groups), participant handles, last message date and unread count. Use the chat id with read_messages, search_messages or send_message. Contact names are not resolved: handles are phone numbers or emails.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read messages of one conversation, newest first. Identify it by chatId (from list_message_chats) or by handle (phone number or email, one-to-one chats only). Optionally restrict to before/after an ISO date.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search message text (case-insensitive substring) across all chats or within one chat, newest first. Scans the most recent ~5000 messages.

tools.name: list_unread_messages
tools.description: List unread incoming messages across all chats, newest first.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send an iMessage/SMS via the Messages app to a handle (phone number or email) or an existing chat (chatId, needed for group chats). Provide exactly one of `to` or `chatId`. Requires confirm: true; without it only a preview of the recipient and exact text is returned and nothing is sent.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search Apple Contacts by name, organisation, nickname, email or phone number (case-insensitive; all words must match). Returns id, name, organisation, phones and emails; use get_contact for full details.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact in full: all phones and emails with labels, postal addresses, organisation, job title, birthday and URLs. The note field is not available.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts sorted by name, one page at a time. Use offset to page through; the summary line shows the total.

tools.name: find_contact_by_phone
tools.description: Find who a phone number belongs to. Matches regardless of formatting and country prefix, so "+49 171 1234567" finds a contact stored as "0171 1234567".

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in the default account. Needs at least a name or an organisation. Birthday as YYYY-MM-DD (or --MM-DD).

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Change a contact. Adding phones/emails/urls (addPhones, addEmails, addUrls) or filling an empty field applies immediately; changing or clearing a field that already has a value requires confirm: true, otherwise it previews. Pass null to clear a field.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search Apple Maps for places (businesses, stations, addresses, landmarks) and return name, address, coordinates, phone, website and category. Read-only; does not open Maps. Without `near`, results come from the Mac's default region. `near` is best effort: results are merged and sorted by distance to that area, but far-away cities can yield few hits; then search for a specific name instead.

tools.name: get_directions
tools.description: Calculate a route between two places with Apple Maps data: distance, expected travel time and (for driving and walking) turn-by-turn steps, plus alternatives. Read-only; does not open Maps (use open_in_maps for that). Transit returns only an estimate of distance and time. `from` and `to` are place names, addresses or "lat,lon"; include the city to avoid ambiguity.

tools.name: open_in_maps
tools.description: UI SIDE EFFECT: opens and brings the Maps app to the front, showing a place search or a route. Use only when the user wants to see it in Maps; for data use search_places or get_directions. Give `query` for a place, or `to` (optionally `from`, default current location) for a route. Cannot save favorites, guides or pins: Maps offers no API for that.

tools.name: list_email_accounts
tools.description: List the accounts configured in Apple Mail, with their email addresses.

tools.name: list_email_folders
tools.description: List Apple Mail folders (mailboxes) with unread and total message counts, optionally for one account.

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: List emails in a folder, newest first, with sender, date, read/flagged state and a short snippet. Defaults to the INBOX of all accounts. Use read_email for the full text and search_emails to look for something.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search emails, newest first. Each word of query must appear (case-insensitive) in the subject, sender name/address or the message preview text; full bodies are not searched. Searches the INBOX unless a folder is given. Optional date range.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read one email in full: plain-text body, recipients (to/cc) and attachment names.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save a new email as a draft in Apple Mail's Drafts folder without sending it and without opening a compose window. No confirmation needed. It lands in the Drafts folder of the sending account and can take a minute to show up in list_emails / search_emails (Mail indexes it after syncing).

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a new email. Requires confirm: true; without it only a preview of from/to/cc/bcc/subject/body is returned and nothing is sent.

tools.name: reply_email
tools.description: Reply to an email. By default only saves a reply DRAFT (quoting the original) that the user can review in Mail. With send: true the reply is sent, which requires confirm: true (otherwise a preview is returned).

tools.name: move_email
tools.description: Move an email to another folder of its account (use list_email_folders for names; "Account/Folder" targets another account). The id stays valid. Moving to Trash/Deleted/Junk/Spam requires confirm: true (otherwise previews); other moves apply directly.

tools.name: mark_email_read
tools.description: Mark an email as read (default) or unread.

tools.name: flag_email
tools.description: Flag (default) or unflag an email.
